The billed figure was $11.58 before the re-map, i.e. BELOW the floor; correcting the supplier variant is what moved it clear. Top competitor review count 921, so the category is not locked. The gate is a floor, not a CPA test - $72.87 clears all three measured CPA benchmarks ($31.16-$47.93) and $27.60 clears none of them.
